In my research I have been interestesd in social science, epidemiological and environmental science topics. I have experience using advanced statistical methods and large-scale datasets to get data-driven insights that can inform public health, social policy, and clinical practice. My academic journey began in psychological research, focusing on therapeutic interventions and clinical research. It then expanded into social policy and public health, and have recently finished my PhD where I specialized in using large registry data linkage to explore the interplay of environmental exposures and health outcomes at a population level. ---
